August 26 Exhaustive Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 145)

This archival dispatch documents the comprehensive provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial multi-part narrative arcs, and story synopses for historical broadcasts transmitting on August 26 across American, British, and international networks, Vaughn Monroe headlining 'Goodnight, Irene' on The Camel Caravan, glamorous movie star Marie McDonald hosting Woody Herman's Thundering Herd on Command Performance, two high-stakes flying squad cases on South Africa's Squad Cars, Stan Kenton and June Christy in Artistry and Rhythm, and Anne Seymour portraying Red Cross founder Clara Barton on The American Challenge (1940–1983):
